battle_start.text: You have come a very long way to be wrong.
Sit down. Ah. No one ever sits.
battle_start.direction: a long pause before the second sentence

battle_start.text: I have kept this hall for a hundred years. I will keep it a little longer.

miss.text: Hm. Clumsy. I was better at this, once.
miss.direction: a flicker of a scholar's self-mockery

crit.text: Every wound has a history. I will remember yours.

kill.text: I will remember your name. Someone ought to.
kill.direction: the warmth breaks through, then is smothered

low_hp.text: Pain. How very vivid. I had forgotten nothing but that.
I have been dying for a century. You will have to do better.

victory.text: Go home. Remember this. Remember all of it.

defeat.text: So. It ends with tired hands, like everything else.
Not yet. There is still a thing I meant to finish.
